name: Littmann Cardiology IV Limited Edition, Red Heart
seoTitle: Littmann Cardiology IV Red Limited Edition
metaDescription: A limited edition Littmann Cardiology IV with a red tube, red logo, and engraved heart on a smoke chestpiece. A striking gift for cardiac and ICU nurses.
summary: A limited edition Cardiology IV with a red tube and an engraved heart on the chestpiece, a fitting gift for a nurse with a big heart for cardiac care.
whyItWorks: Most stethoscopes blend in. This limited edition Cardiology IV is meant to stand out, with a red tube, a red logo on the diaphragm, and a heart engraved on a smoke finish chestpiece. For a cardiac nurse, a cath lab nurse, or anyone who loves a bit of red in their look, the heart detail feels like it was chosen with them in mind. It also makes a sweet Valentine's Day or anniversary gift from a partner who wants something both romantic and useful.

Beyond the look, it belongs to Littmann's Cardiology IV line, which many nurses consider a career level stethoscope. That means the gift will be used daily rather than admired once and put away. A distinct design is also practical in a busy unit, where identical stethoscopes get mixed up at the nurses station. The title lists a 27 inch tube and a black stem, so you know the general look before ordering. Since it is a limited edition, it is worth buying when you see it rather than waiting.
goodToKnow: Limited editions can sell out, so confirm availability and the seller on the listing before planning around a date.
A red tube is bold, so consider whether the recipient prefers classic colors.
Pair it with a heart themed badge reel for a matching set.

faq.q: Is this a good Valentine's Day gift for a nurse?
faq.a: It is one of the more thoughtful options, since the engraved heart and red tube suit the holiday while still being something they use every shift.

faq.q: Is it a different model from the regular Cardiology IV?
faq.a: It is a limited edition version of the Cardiology IV with its own color and finish details, listed as model 6182.
